name: Haiku growth at a reasonable price
strategy: Optimized defensive value with healthcare and energy focus, maintaining growth hedges through semiconductor equipment and crypto; elevated cash for macro volatility.
reassessment_note: Rotating away from underperforming ABT (-22.45% YTD) which drags portfolio; increasing conviction in UNH (+11.75% YTD) as secular healthcare growth driver with pricing power; maintaining energy exposure (NEE, XLE) for inflation hedge and dividend income; keeping ASML and reduced BTC as growth hedges in market regime favoring large-cap quality; raising cash from 46% to 50% for defensiveness in elevated-rate environment (Fed at 3.75%-4.00% with additional hikes pricing in); this adjustment maintains defensive value mandate while improving risk/reward.

positions.thesis: Healthcare quality leader with strong pricing power, secular aging demographics tailwind, and premium valuation justified by consistent earnings growth; up 11.75% YTD with UNH earnings beat expectations; core defensive holding capturing demographic and pricing power trends.

Dominant consumer staples franchise with 136-year dividend history and 70 consecutive years of dividend increases; pricing power across Tide, Gillette, Pampers portfolio protects margins in high-rate environment; defensive stable anchor position.

Asset-light concentrate licensing model with high ROIC; 64 consecutive years of dividend increases; yield-accretive for defensive income; regional bottler capital discipline reduces balance sheet risk in uncertain macro.

Pharmaceutical quality with diversified portfolio; reduced from prior weight due to modest +10.68% YTD performance; pharmaceutical exposure provides non-cyclical earnings stream; maintained for sector diversification.
Renewable energy infrastructure with durable long-term power purchase agreements; inflation hedge and yield supporting defensive allocation; clean energy thesis aligns with secular ESG tailwinds.
Energy sector exposure for inflation hedge and yield; provides non-correlative diversification to healthcare/staples; commodity leverage if oil prices hold above $60 supports portfolio ballast.

Semiconductor equipment secular growth engine with AI demand sustaining capex cycle; only exposure to high-growth secular trend within defensive mandate; ASML up 3.07% YTD with pricing power in AI infrastructure build-out.

Reduced crypto exposure from 2% to 1% for cash flexibility while maintaining upside to $90K+ price targets; BTC momentum intact with hedge against currency debasement; token position size appropriate for growth hedge within conservative allocation.
